last_result.content:
## 5.2 Security Incident Notification

Provider will notify Customer without undue delay and in no event later than twenty-four
hours after Provider becomes aware of a Security Incident affecting Customer Data. The notice
will describe the known scope of the incident, the categories of Customer Data involved, and
the steps Provider is taking to contain and remediate it.

action.title: Security Incident Notification Timing
action.analysis: The Security Exhibit requires Kestrel to notify Meridian of a security incident affecting Customer Data within 24 hours of becoming aware of it. However, the playbook recommends a notification within 1 hour to ensure rapid response and containment of potential breaches.
action.recommendation: We should negotiate for a shorter notification window to align with our playbook recommendations.

quotes.text: Provider will notify Customer without undue delay and in no event later than twenty-four hours after Provider becomes aware of a Security Incident affecting Customer Data.
